title.en: Fable 24 — The Donkey in the Lion's Skin

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.ar: חמור מצא עור של אריה בשדה.
sentences.en: A donkey found a lion’s skin in the field.

sentences.ar: הוא לבש אותו והלך בין הכפרים.
sentences.en: He put it on and walked between the villages.
All the animals ran from him in fear.
He opened his mouth and brayed.
They all understood at once who he was.
